top: This is not a painting, and it's not AI. It's a real wave on Lake Erie.
comment: Photographer Cody Evans took about 10,000 photos during a November 2022 storm. One frame caught a face in the water. He named it “Poseidon's Wrath.”
topic_it: La foto 'Poseidon's Wrath' di Cody Evans (Port Stanley, lago Erie, novembre 2022): un'onda che sembra un volto

title: This haunting wave face is 100% real #nature #scary #waves
description:
